description: A global base temperature dataset for building energy demand modeling is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Xiujuan He, Jiyong Eom (University of Hong Kong). Accurate building energy demand modeling can inform the decarbonization of regional energy systems. The cooling and heating degree-day models are widely used due to their simplicity and low data requirements; however, the lack of accurate base temperature data limits their performance. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 201145141 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
